title: Integral monoid pushout along a submonoid to a group embeds in a group
statement:
Let $P$ be a commutative monoid, written multiplicatively, whose canonical map to its group completion $P^{\mathrm{gp}}$ (the monoid algebra construction in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]) is injective. Here the group completion is the abelian group obtained by formally adjoining inverses, with its universal homomorphism from $P$. Let $E\subseteq P$ be a submonoid and let $f:E\to G$ be a monoid homomorphism to an abelian group $G$, with no injectivity assumption on $f$. Define $M=P\oplus_E G$ as the quotient of $P\times G$ by the monoid congruence generated by $(pe,g)\sim(p,f(e)g)$ for $e\in E$. Write $f^{\mathrm{gp}}:E^{\mathrm{gp}}\to G$ for the extension, and regard $E^{\mathrm{gp}}$ as a subgroup of $P^{\mathrm{gp}}$. Put
$$H=(P^{\mathrm{gp}}\times G)/\{(z,f^{\mathrm{gp}}(z)^{-1}):z\in E^{\mathrm{gp}}\}.$$
The homomorphism $M\to H$ induced by $(p,g)\mapsto[(p,g)]$ is injective. In particular $M$ embeds in its group completion and is cancellative. The canonical map $G\to M$, $g\mapsto[1,g]$, is injective, and its multiplication action on $M$ is free. For $p,p'\in P$ and $g,g'\in G$, equality $[p,g]=[p',g']$ holds if and only if there exist $e,e'\in E$ such that
$$pe'=p'e\quad\hbox{and}\quad g f(e)=g'f(e').$$

from.place: Proof Step 3: dimension-normalized Verdier duality, regular finite-torsion local model; pointwise purity and composition used to compare the normalized curve with the ambient regular scheme. Input: Gabber purity for a regular Noetherian closed pair. More precisely: Expose XVI, section 3.7 second paragraph through its last paragraph, printed pp.254--255: semistable G-alteration, ell-Sylow H, tame equivariant modification, quotient over T=S prime/H, and log resolution. Geometric construction only, before applying Theorem 3.6.2 and Proposition 3.5.7; preliminary finite extension to normalize constants in the first paragraph. Specifically: XVI 3.7, p.255: 'Le log-schema X''' est regulier et log-lisse sur T', in the uniformizer-chart form required by Theorem 3.6.2 via Proposition 3.6.3. Internal chart argument: Expose XVI Proposition 3.6.3 proof, last paragraph, printed p.252, inverse-image monoid P=h^{-1}(M_x) and etale comparison; refinement of Kato (1988) Theorem 3.5 recalled in that paragraph. Auxiliary associated-log construction on the arbitrary infinitesimal test schemes in the prescribed-chart comparison argument. Algebraic input: adjoining unit values to an integral chart monoid, for integrality and cancellation in the infinitesimal chart test.
